characters.name_or_role: Woman at dinner table (SPEAKER_00, the ranting partner)
personality_traits: Assertive and confrontational - opens the scene with a direct accusation ('You're not listening to me')
Articulate and quick with escalating, specific arguments rather than vague complaints
Emotionally expressive - relies on wide eyes, raised eyebrows and pointed hand gestures to punctuate her speech
Perceptive/suspicious of her partner's real attention rather than his literal gaze ('You're waiting for me to finish so you can say the thing you were already going to say')
emotional_range: Mild irritation at the top of the scene
Building exasperation as she lists evidence
Peaks at wide-eyed, open-mouthed incredulity by the final line
expressions: 0:00-0:01 - eyebrows raised, composed but pointed look while starting the accusation
0:02 ("AT") - eyebrows lifted further, mouth open mid-declaration, eyes wide and fixed on him
0:03 ("FACE.") - same wide-eyed, open-mouth insistence, leaning slightly forward
0:05-0:07 - eyes wide, mouth ajar in a look of disbelief as she delivers the final, most cutting line
gestures: 0:00-0:01 - seated upright, turned toward her partner, direct eye contact
0:02 ("AT") - right index finger raised and jabbed upward to emphasize her point
0:03-0:07 - stays turned toward him, posture leaning in slightly, no retreat or softening
characters.interactions_notes: She is the sole audible speaker in this clip and drives the entire exchange; she maintains steady eye contact and leans toward her partner throughout, using a raised finger to punctuate her key phrase. She is visually and conversationally dominant in the scene - his silence and blank expression give her monologue nowhere to land, which is the source of the scene's tension.

characters.name_or_role: Man at dinner table (silent partner, the 'low battery' character)
personality_traits: Checked-out and passive - never speaks or reacts on camera despite being directly accused
Physically present but emotionally absent, embodying the series' 'low battery people' concept of going through the motions without being present
Unbothered/unreadable - his droopy, half-lidded expression does not shift even as accusations escalate
emotional_range: Flat, tired disengagement for the entire scene
No visible escalation, defensiveness, or surprise even as he is called out
expressions: 0:00 (title card) - droopy half-lidded eyes, slack open mouth, a caption reading 'LISTENING' ironically overlaid on his blank face
0:04 ("WERE") - same sagging, tired eyes, mouth slightly open, no change in affect
0:06 ("THING") - identical flat, half-lidded stare directly ahead, largely motionless
gestures: 0:01-0:02 - seen from behind holding a dark rectangular object (phone/device) up near his face, visually explaining why he is not truly present
0:03-0:07 - upright but static in his chair, no hand gestures, no lean toward or away from her, head barely moving
characters.interactions_notes: He is filmed largely from behind or in flat medium shots, in contrast to the close, expressive coverage given to her - a visual power imbalance that mirrors the dialogue. He offers no verbal rebuttal in this clip and his one physical action (holding up a device) is the visual proof of the woman's accusation that he isn't really listening. His stillness and lack of eye-contact engagement make him the passive target of her frustration rather than an active participant in the conversation.
